021@HistoryLogProps(
022    opCode = 26,

026public class AlertClearedHistoryLog extends HistoryLog {

028    private long alertId;

031    public AlertClearedHistoryLog() {}
032    public AlertClearedHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, long alertId, long faultLocatorData) {
033        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
034        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, alertId, faultLocatorData);
035        this.alertId = alertId;
036        this.faultLocatorData = faultLocatorData;
037

039

047

051     * <tr><td><code>alertId</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 10)</code></td></tr>
052     * <tr><td><code>faultLocatorData</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 14)</code></td></tr>
053     * </table>
054     */
055    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
056        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
057        this.cargo = raw;
058        parseBase(raw);
059        this.alertId = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 10);
060        this.faultLocatorData = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 14);
061
062    }
063
064    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, long alertId, long faultLocatorData) {
065        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
066            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(26, 0),
067            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
068            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
069            Bytes.toUint32(alertId),
070            Bytes.toUint32(faultLocatorData)));

072

079    }
080
081    public AlertStatusResponse.AlertResponseType getAlertResponseType() {
